_comment: MessageHub (application-service/messagehub) -- NEW product added in the 2026-09 catalog rebuild (data/api_catalog.json 1,490 endpoints), 0 prior coverage. 29 endpoints across 4 resource families: domain (5), email (8), phone (9), push-application (7, but NO create endpoint -- see messagehub-pushapplication-coverage). Authored as a MODELING pass (docs-derived bodies from data/api_bodies.json + live doc pages fetched 2026-09-18 + the search-index text via spec.extract_catalog.index_body_texts) -- this agent ran ONLY read-only live GETs to confirm host/auth (SCP_ALLOW_MUTATIONS=false SCP_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE=false throughout), per its mandate. Host: https://messagehub.<region>.<env>.samsungsdscloud.com (standard regional template, no SCP_SERVICE_HOSTS override needed) -- LIVE-CONFIRMED 2026-09-18 (kr-west1/e): GET /v1/domains, /v1/emails, /v1/phones, /v1/push-applications all -> 200 with an empty resource list (account has none of any resource type yet). All create/delete + the private-acl/public-acl/private-endpoint/use-caller setters are 202 Accepted AsyncResponse ({account_id, global_request_id, resource_id}) per docs; the *description* setters are synchronous 200 (return the full Show-shape response). Mutations in this file are NOT yet runtime-proven -- next agent with a live-mutation budget should run this lifecycle for real, fix whatever the first real 400 says (masked-defect lesson: the tolerant expects here are honestly flagged as unvalidated, not silently hiding a known-broken call), and tighten expect_status once proven.

steps._note: DomainCreateRequest per data/api_bodies.json createdomain. Hard expect [202] (create is the one step this lifecycle needs to actually succeed to prove anything -- masked-defect rule: don't widen the create's expect).

lifecycles._note: BLOCKER, not masked-defect (2026-09-18 catalog rebuild): there is NO createpushapplication endpoint anywhere in the 1,490-endpoint catalog -- confirmed by grepping core.catalog.endpoints() for every 'push' key/path across ALL services, only list/show/delete/set{description,private-acl,public-acl,private-endpoint} exist (7 endpoints total incl. listpushapplications which is already smoke-floor-reachable). Push-application resources are evidently provisioned out-of-band (console-only, or a not-yet-cataloged mobile-push registration flow) -- this is a genuine product/catalog gap, not something this agent can work around by creating a resource. LIVE-CONFIRMED 2026-09-18 (read-only): GET /v1/push-applications -> 200 {"count":0,"push_applications":[],...} -- this test account currently has ZERO push applications, so the 6 id-bound endpoints below have no real id to target from this account alone. Mirrors the devopsservice-write-coverage pattern (regression/scenarios/lifecycles/devops-tools__devopsservice.json): list-first with capture_soft (adopts a real id if/when one exists, e.g. created by another agent/human via console) then every id-bound step is optional+tolerant so it still statically closes the GAP-get-id/GAP-write entries (the point of a modeling pass) while being honest that a green run here does NOT yet prove a real 2xx. RECORD AS A BLOCKER in the coverage ledger: 'needs a push-application created out-of-band (console) or a createpushapplication endpoint added to the API before these 6 endpoints can be truly covered' -- next agent/orchestrator should check if the console (or a newer API version) exposes a create path before spending more time here.
